QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off (default; `mbedtls_config.h:208` is commented out) | `#define mbedtls_calloc calloc` (plain libc, `platform.h:166-167`)
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that in the default config (PLATFORM_MEMORY off) mbedtls_calloc is a macro defined directly as calloc, i.e. no indirection. Its table row names only calloc, and the free half of the claim is not stated verbatim, but the cited lines 166-167 cover both macros.
